description: Have the assistant draft a test from a plain-language description, or revise a plan, without saving anything. Returns the proposed steps, checks, values to record, assumptions and any questions only the requester can answer. Show the plan to the requester; to change it, call again with `plan` and `change`; to answer questions, pass `answers`. Once they confirm, pass the plan to create_test. When no question is open the plan has passed the planning review (review.ok). Pass projectId so the assistant knows the project's sign-in accounts and endpoints. Each call uses one assistant draft of the workspace's daily allowance. Reference: https://testsy.dev/docs/mcp/

answers.description: Answers to the questions of an earlier plan_test call, keyed by question id

appId.description: Apps: package name or bundle id

change.description: With plan: what to change, for example "also check the price on the cart page"

description.description: What to test, as you would brief a colleague

plan.description: A plan from an earlier plan_test call, to revise

url.description: Start address (https://…); omit for app tests

name: plan_test
title: Draft or revise a plan
